content: Venice lagoon waterfront in bright clear morning sun: ornate three-arm Venetian cast-iron lamppost with pink glass lanterns standing centre frame against an empty blue sky; wide stone quay, gondola moorings with gondolas under blue covers, yellow/green tarp bundles bottom right, San Giorgio Maggiore and its campanile on the far horizon. No people.
location: Venice - lagoon waterfront gondola moorings facing San Giorgio Maggiore (Riva degli Schiavoni / Molo San Marco area)
camera_motion: near-static handheld (locked-off feel) 0-5.8 s with tiny drift; at ~6 s starts moving left/forward as the clip ends
composition_notes: centred lamppost silhouette against clean sky, clear layers: quay foreground, gondolas midground, lagoon and San Giorgio horizon; level horizon
exposure_notes: crisp and steady; bright morning sun, sky not clipped, shadow side of lamppost dark, light haze on horizon

best_moments.why: steady postcard frame: Venetian lamppost centred vs blue sky, gondolas and San Giorgio on the horizon

fx.hud_track: lamppost lantern head as a static lock-on target 0-5.5 s
fx.rotoscope: lamppost against plain blue sky 0-5.5 s - easy matte to put giant text behind the lamp

notes: Venice, not Rome. Short (6.3 s); city certain from gondolas/Venetian lamp/lagoon, exact quay inferred. Last ~0.3 s camera moves.

content: Rialto Bridge, sunny morning: POV climbing the white stone steps between the bridge's arcaded shop rows (shutters still down) with tourists coming down, then pushing through a dense crowd past shopfronts (backpacks filling frame), ending at the bridge balustrade with a view down the Grand Canal - palazzi, boats, blue sky - over a foreground of tourist heads and hats.
camera_motion: handheld forward walk up the steps (push-in) with small pans L/R 0-9 s; slow crowded walk 9-15 s; near-static at the balustrade 15-21 s looking along the Grand Canal; quick pan left/tilt down at ~21.5 s
composition_notes: steps and shop arcades give symmetry and leading lines 4-7.5 s; mid section blocked by people's backs; canal view is attractive but the lower third is cluttered with heads
exposure_notes: harsh sun, deep shade under the arcades vs bright sky; motion blur in the crowd section 9-15 s (sharp x0.6-0.8); canal view 18-21.5 s crisp

best_moments.why: symmetric climb up the Rialto steps between shop arcades, people descending
Grand Canal panorama from the Rialto, palazzi and boats, crowd foreground

fx.hud_track: man in light shirt walking down the steps towards camera ~4-5.5 s
fx.fg_wipe: backpack/shoulder of passer-by fills left half of the lens ~2-3 s; crowd backs ~9-11 s

notes: Venice, not Rome. Very crowded; passer-by faces close to lens at ~2.5 s and ~5 s.

content: Sunny paved square ringed by arcaded buildings (stone porticoes, red-plastered facade): square stone fountain pillar with bronze lion/grotesque-head spouts; strangers refilling plastic water bottles (man in black T-shirt and sunglasses, older woman in pink cap, woman in striped top and sun hat), close-up of a hand holding a bottle under a spout; ends tilting down into the basin with the operator's fingers and shadow in frame. Harsh mid-morning light.
camera_motion: handheld and shaky: push-in towards the fountain with slight tilt/roll 0-6 s, roughly static on the spout 6-9 s, tilt down into the basin with pull-out 9-12 s
composition_notes: fountain pillar dominates the left/centre, candid bottle-filling moment; cluttered start, ends on hand and basin
exposure_notes: harsh sun, bright stone vs deep shade under the arcades; visible handheld shake; sharp enough mid-clip

best_moments.why: bronze lion spouts pouring into a held bottle, arcaded square behind
man leaning in to fill a bottle at the fountain

fx.hud_track: man in black T-shirt leaning in to fill a bottle 0-2 s

notes: Square not identifiable from frames; probably Venice (shot 20 min after the Rialto clip DJI_0120, before San Polo clips). Strangers' faces at 0-3.5 s. Same fountain as DJI_0122/0123.

content: Locked-off close-up of the same square's fountain: weathered marble pillar with a bronze lion-head spout pouring a thin sunlit arc of water into the basin; background a red-plastered building with white-framed windows over a dark arcaded ground floor and sunny paving with white stone stripes; a pigeon flies through ~14 s. No people.
camera_motion: static (camera resting on the fountain); slight roll settle 0-3 s and tiny push/pull 3-9 s, fully locked 9-24 s
composition_notes: textured stone and bronze head in the left third with the water arc leading to the background arcade; tight, layered detail shot
exposure_notes: sharp and steady; harsh sun, pillar highlights slightly hot, shadows under the arcade crushed

best_moments.why: locked-off bronze lion spout with sparkling water arc, pigeon crossing near the end

notes: 29.97 fps (30p) unlike most 60p clips - no slow-mo headroom. Square unidentified (probably Venice by timeline). Fountain detail cutaway.

content: Camera left resting on the fountain rim, aimed into the basin at a skewed angle: wet stone basin glowing golden in the sun, white splash under the spout, basin wall, with the square's arcade and passers-by's legs along the top edge; at ~19-22 s it is picked up and swings into a blurry low-angle selfie of a young man in a cap and white shirt against blue sky and the red arcaded building.

composition_notes: accidental-looking tilted frame into the basin; selfie ending is blurred with the face very close
exposure_notes: steady during the static part but sunlit basin water and splash blown out; selfie at the end blurred (sharp x0.3-0.8)

content: Inside a busy sandwich/deli bar under warm light: glass display counters full of panini and tramezzini, bread rolls stacked on top, bottles on shelves, young server behind the counter; a man with sunglasses on his head and a woman with long dark hair, green top and brown leather bag strap queueing in the foreground; long stretches pointing down into the glass case with reflections and a bright window glare.

composition_notes: cluttered - backs of heads in the foreground, glass reflections; only a few frames show the food clearly

content: Venice: view from a footbridge down a narrow sunlit canal lined with old brick and plaster houses, window boxes and purple wisteria on a balcony, small motorboats moored, people on the fondamenta, 'Parochia S. Cassian' sign on the right wall; mid-clip the camera drops to the operator's white sneakers on the white stone bridge steps and a companion's legs before returning to the canal view. Harsh late-morning sun.
location: Ponte de le Tette area, San Polo (parish of San Cassiano), Venice
camera_motion: handheld: canal view 0-0.7 s, fast tilt down/pan left to feet on the bridge steps 1-4 s (blurred), tilt back up ~4-4.5 s, steady canal view 4.5-7.1 s
composition_notes: canal perspective with a vanishing point and layered facades in the good part; middle third is pocket footage of feet
exposure_notes: canal view sharp (sharp x1.4) with bright sky and deep shadow on the left wall; 1.5-4 s heavily motion-blurred

best_moments.why: steady view down the canal: boats, wisteria balcony, people on the fondamenta

fx.whip: fast tilt down at ~1.0-1.6 s and back up at ~4.0-4.5 s (motion blur) usable as a whip

notes: Venice, not Rome. Same canal view as the start of DJI_0126 (shot 35 s later, which also shows the readable street signs). 1.5-4 s unusable (feet).

content: Venice backstreets in harsh late-morning sun: view down a narrow canal from a bridge (boats, green shutters, flower boxes, people on the fondamenta), pan past the nizioleto sign 'Sestier de S. Polo / Ponte de le Tette / Sotoportego e Corte de Ca' Bollani', along the canal with the bridge parapet in the foreground, then a small brick-and-stone arched footbridge with a man in a teal T-shirt walking over and down its steps towards camera (10-13.5 s), the 'Parochia S. Cassian' wall with a moored motorboat, a fast pan away and a blurry follow of a man in a white shirt with a shoulder bag down a sunny calle.

camera_motion: slow handheld pan left throughout 0-15 s (quick swing to the sign 1-2.5 s), near-pause on the arched bridge 9-14 s; fast whip-pan left with push-in 16.3-17.8 s; blurry forward walk behind a man 18-20.5 s ending pointing at the ground
composition_notes: low angle on the arched footbridge with canal houses and blue sky behind - layered foreground/mid/background; strong diagonals from the bridge parapet

content: Dessert close-up in a dim cafe: cocoa-dusted tiramisu in a clear cup and a pistachio cream cup topped with crushed pistachios on a brown plastic tray with a printed paper liner and white plastic spoon, paper cup in the background; low warm tungsten light.

content: Interior of a shop/cafe: dark wooden shelves of wine bottles over a tiled floor, then a swing right into a bright self-service bar with glass food counters, menu screens and a large black-and-white ink-drawing cityscape mural; customers standing at a long ledge (man in white T-shirt and cap, people with backpacks).
